title: Drop or wire up dead ARB keys milestoneAggregate/recentActivityShort pinned by b1_vocab_keys_present_test.dart
rule: AG-6-adjacent dead code / Evans ubiquitous language (vocabulary the app doesn't actually speak)
why: grep -rn '\bmilestoneAggregate\b' and '\brecentActivityShort\b' across lib/ match only the generated lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart files — no screen or widget calls either getter. This test locks both into the ARB contract forever, and a sibling test's comment (test/core/labels/domain_term_labels_vocab_test.dart:114-116: 'milestone, milestoneAggregate, ... — removed from DomainTermLabels ... tested through widget-level integration tests, not here') claims coverage that doesn't exist for these two keys, so translators keep maintaining EN/HE strings nobody reads and nothing actually exercises the values this test pins.
recommendation: Either wire milestoneAggregate/recentActivityShort into the screen(s) they were written for, or delete them from both ARBs, this test's _b1VocabKeys list, and the stale comment in domain_term_labels_vocab_test.dart.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn '\bmilestoneAggregate\b\|\brecentActivityShort\b' lib/ --include=*.dart shows a call site outside lib/l10n/, OR both keys are removed from app_en.arb, app_he.arb, and this test's _b1VocabKeys list

corrections: The 'why' prose cites domain_term_labels_vocab_test.dart:114-116 for a quote that actually conflates two separate comment blocks: lines 86-89 (covers milestone/milestoneAggregate, has the 'tested through widget-level integration tests, not here' phrase) and lines 114-116 (covers tierLens*/recentActivityShort, but only says 'served as structural strings via AppLocalizations', no testing claim). The composite quote as attributed to :114-116 doesn't exist verbatim there. Core dead-key claim is unaffected — independently verified true regardless of this mis-citation.
